function.name: tool
function.description:
Description:
Each tools array item is one complete DSL command string. Enabled commands: read, grep, find, list, bash, web, fetch, edit, write, todo, agent.
Call only tool. Do not call read, grep, find, list, bash, web, fetch, edit, write, todo, agent directly.
Use only command strings here, not JSON object syntax inside the array items.
Use single-line commands for read, grep, find, list, bash, web, fetch, agent.
Use multiline bodies only for edit, write, todo.
For edit, write, todo, keep the header line and the entire multiline body in the same string.
For edit, the path header and every oldText/newText block must all be in that same string.
Do not wrap commands in code fences, markdown bullets, numbering, or explanatory prose.
Do not describe commands with quoted tool names or quoted path values.
Quote values only when needed to keep spaces grouped.
Read: read files. Ranges are optional. Use start-end for line ranges, Hn for the first n lines, and Tn for the last n lines.
Grep: search text. Use | for multiple queries. Optional path. Prefer 'in <path>' when a path is present.
Find: find files or patterns. Use | for multiple names or patterns. Optional path. Prefer 'in <path>' when a path is present.
List: list files. The path is required. Use . as the path for the current working directory.
Bash: run a shell command. Prefer 'in <path>' when a cwd is present.
Web: search the web.
Fetch: fetch a URL.
Agent: delegate a focused task to a sub-agent.
Edit: replace exact existing text in files. Copy oldText exactly from the current file, including indentation. lineRange is only a hint. Use one or more oldText/newText block pairs in the same multiline string.
Write: write a full file.
Todo: set or replace the todo list with markdown checklist items.

Syntax:
read <path> [optional ranges]
Ranges may be inline as path:40-60,80-90,T20, path:L40-60, path:H20, or path:T20.
grep <query> [in <path>]
Use | inside the query for multiple terms.
find <pattern> [in <path>]
Use commas for multiple patterns. Brace globs like *.{ts,tsx} stay as one pattern.
list <path>
Use . as the path value for the current working directory.
bash <command> [in <path>]
web <query>
fetch <url>
agent <prompt>
edit <path>
oldText [lineRange?]:
Exact existing file text
newText:
Replacement text

[Additional oldText/newText blocks in the same string, separated by a blank line]
write <path>
Full file content
todo <optional title>
[ ] item
[-] item
[x] item

Examples:
Examples below are exact command strings.
Do not add quotes, bullets, numbering, backticks, or trailing punctuation.
read src/app.ts:40-60,80-90,T20
grep authservice|pizza|text in src
find package.json,tsconfig.json in src
list .
bash npm run build in src
web python apps
fetch https://example.com
agent analyze the current project structure
edit src/app.ts
oldText 10-12:
const loading = false
newText:
const loading = true

oldText 20-22:
const error = null
newText:
const error = undefined
write notes.txt
build passed
todo Implementation
[ ] Analyze requirements
[-] Update parser
[x] Add tests

calls.description: One complete tool DSL command per string. Must contain at least one command. No prose. Inline commands stay single-line. Edit/write/todo may use multiline bodies, but the header and body must stay in the same string. For edit, every oldText/newText block belongs in that same string.

items.description: A single complete command in the tool DSL. Multiline edit/write/todo commands must include both the header line and the full body in this one string. For edit, include the path header plus all oldText/newText blocks together.
